Explore OPWDD, NHTD, and TBI program questions with Kamilla. Contact her to discuss the assistance available for your situation.

01 / OPWDD

Developmental disability advocacy

New York’s Office for People With Developmental Disabilities connects eligible individuals with developmental disability supports. The Front Door process is the starting point for accessing services.

Speak with Kamilla about navigating the process, understanding program information, and questions to bring to the appropriate agencies.

Discuss OPWDD ↗
02 / NHTD

Exploring community living

The Nursing Home Transition and Diversion waiver is designed to help eligible people receive support in community settings. Participation depends on program requirements and approval.

Contact Kamilla to discuss your questions about the program and its referral pathway.

Discuss NHTD ↗
03 / TBI

Understanding brain injury support

New York’s Traumatic Brain Injury waiver supports eligible individuals in living in the community. Regional Resource Development Centers are part of the program access process.

Start a conversation about the information and next steps relevant to your needs.

Discuss TBI ↗
